decisions.reason: As a peripheral consumer product with only a brief website mention and no evidence of traction, its option value is limited and its continuing costs likely outweigh the uncertain upside.
This is a core extension of the established waste-to-energy business with ongoing strategic value and low resolution of uncertainty, so it is worth keeping open.
Having its own website page signals greater commitment and likely more favorable results, so its option value remains high and the cost of keeping it is justified.
It is close to the established offer and still uncertain enough to warrant retention, though less prominent than C so a slightly higher drop probability.
